cards.card_text: Leaving the next day, they go on to Caesarea and stay at the home of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven chosen to serve the church (Acts 6:2-5).
cards.verse_text: Leaving the next day, we went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the Seven.
cards.snippet: …went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the Seven.

cards.card_text: Then evangelists, and pastors and teachers.
cards.verse_text: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
cards.snippet: …gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,

cards.card_text: Paul tells Timothy to do the work of an evangelist.
cards.verse_text: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
cards.snippet: …be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
